Definition
[Higher covariant derivatives] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0298 ↗ appa-def-covariant-derivative-general-tensor 1. Section A.5\group notation-for-higher-derivatives

For $k>1$, the source considers operators \[ abla ^k : C^\infty \! \left(T^q_p \mathcal M^n ight) o C^\infty \! \left(T^q_{p+k} \mathcal M^n ight). \] If $A\in C^\infty (T^q_p \mathcal M^n)$ and $X_1,\ldots ,X_k$ are vector fields, then \[ abla _{X_1} abla _{X_2}\cdots abla _{X_k}A \] denotes the unique $(p,q)$-tensor field satisfying \[ ( abla _{X_1} abla _{X_2}\cdots abla _{X_k}A)(Y_1,\ldots ,Y_p;\, heta _1,\ldots , heta _q) = ( abla ^k A)(X_1,X_2,\ldots ,X_k,Y_1,\ldots ,Y_p;\, heta _1,\ldots , heta _q). \]
